current_disclosures.section: Risks Related to Regulatory, Legal, Our Stock, and Other Matters
current_disclosures.summary: The company is subject to complex laws and political actions, including export restrictions on its products, which may adversely impact its business.

materiality_analysis.reason: The disclosure explicitly adds 'restrictions on the export of our products' to the general risk of complex laws and political actions. Given Nvidia's global supply chain and market exposure, the specific inclusion of export restrictions is a material change in the regulatory risk profile.

comparisons.peer_summary: Government actions and regulations may limit the company's ability to export products to certain customers.
comparisons.comparison: Both NVDA and AMD disclose risks related to government regulations limiting their ability to export products. NVDA broadly states it is subject to political actions that may adversely impact its business (citing export restrictions in its forward-looking context), while AMD explicitly warns that government actions and regulations may limit its ability to export products to certain customers.

sentences.text: • We are subject to complex laws, rules and regulations, and political and other actions, which may adversely impact our business.
◦Government actions and regulations may limit our ability to export our products to certain customers.
